expectation: Membrane-ring stain on B cells (naive, memory, germinal centre), absent in plasma cells. B cells should be a minority of the tissue, clustered in lymphoid follicles or aggregates, with few scattered single cells elsewhere.
observed: A: yellow is concentrated in a few dense focal aggregates in separate ROI tiles, and other tiles carry only sparse speckle. B and C are nearly empty, as expected for follicle-restricted cells. D: crisp membrane outlines on tightly packed cells.
why: CD20 signal forms discrete follicle-like clusters of membrane-outlined cells and is absent from most tissue, which fits B-cell aggregates rather than haze.
